_traps: Section 2.2 says 'Neither Grantor shall serve as Trustee' - a negative statement; the grantors must NOT get trustee roles.
Trustee Rebecca L. Bradley and grantor Robert W. Bradley II are both 'R. Bradley' and live at 410 vs 4410 Quail Hollow Rd (different ZIPs). Never merge them.
Only one successor is named (Daniel P. Whitaker); after him, a bank or trust company 'may' be appointed. That generic fallback names no entity and must not become one.
Schedule A links the trust to a company (1,500 shares of Quail Hollow Holdings, Inc.) and to the J.P. Morgan account; the account number is masked (XXX-X7731-0).
Cover page and body both list parties; extract each role once (cover is a summary, body is authoritative).
